title: trichilia aquifolia
intro: Trichilia aquifolia, commonly known as the Yellow Mombin, is a tropical plant species belonging to the family Meliaceae. The health benefits of Trichilia aquifolia include its potential to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant involve its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion and cough, and as an anti-inflammatory agent, reducing swelling and pain. The bioactive constituents of Trichilia aquifolia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
